violations.description: General employee practices. — --Food employee observed without proper hair restraint. Food employee was observed without a hair restraint. Hair should be restrained when preparing food.

Preventing contamination by employees. — --Employee observed using same pair of single-use gloves for more than one task. Observed food employee with gloved hands discard sandwiches from the hot holding unit, then handle a pen to document discarded items and then prepared pizzas for lunch and did not change gloves between tasks. Gloves should be changed between tasks.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. Multiple food items in the walk-in cooler were found without date markings. Potentially hazardous foods should be date marked when they are prepared so they can be discarded in a timely manner.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Cover for fan near the register was found dirty. Inside of the microwave in the back prep area was also found dirty. These should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not stored in a clean, dry manner to protect from contamination. Clean utensils were found stored in dirty containers on the shelving unit in the back prep area. Clean utensils and equipment should be stored in a clean location.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Wall behind the oven in the back prep area was found dirty. This should be cleaned and maintained clean.

General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Observed food employee put on gloves without washing his hands. Observed another employee put on hand sanitizer when switching gloves.. Hands should be washed before putting gloves on and between glove changes. Hand sanitizer can not be used as a substitute for hand washing.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --Employees' clothing/possessions were in an area where contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items may occur. Employee drinks were observed on shelving unit in the kitchen with clean linens. Personal items should be stored separate from items used for food service.
